40023102.author: पदार्थः
40023102.content: शृणु Listen, राजन् O King, महासत्व O greatly courageous one, यदर्थम् for what purpose, अहम् I, आगतः have come, पितामहेन by the grandfather, देवेन the god, प्रेषितः sent, अस्मि I am, महाबल O mighty-armed one.

40023102.author: Translation
40023102.content: The sage then began, asking Rama to listen, and revealed that he had been sent by the divine grandfather Brahma for a specific purpose.

40023103.author: पदार्थः
40023103.content: तव your, अहम् I, पूर्वसद्भावे in a previous existence, पुत्रः son, परपुरञ्जय O conqueror of enemy cities, मायासम्भावितः created by Maya, वीर O hero, कालः Time, सर्वसमाहरः the destroyer of all.

40023103.author: Translation
40023103.content: O conqueror of enemy cities, O hero, I am your son from a previous existence, created by your divine power as Time, the destroyer of all.

40023104.author: पदार्थः
40023104.content: पितामहः Grandfather Brahma, च and, भगवान् the revered one, आह said, लोकपतिः lord of the worlds, प्रभुः the mighty one, समयः an agreement, ते by you, कृतः made, सौम्य O gentle one, लोकान् the worlds, सम्परिरक्षितुम् to protect well.

40023104.author: Translation
40023104.content: And the revered Grandfather Brahma, the mighty lord of the worlds, said, "O gentle one, an agreement has been made by you to protect the worlds well."

40023105.author: पदार्थः
40023105.content: सङ्क्षिप्य having dissolved, हि indeed, पुरा formerly, लोकान् the worlds, मायया by Maya, स्वयमेव by yourself alone, हि indeed, महार्णवे in the great ocean, शयानः lying, अप्सु in the waters, माम् me, त्वम् you, पूर्वम् formerly, अजीजनः begot.

40023105.author: Translation
40023105.content: Indeed, formerly, having dissolved the worlds by your own divine power, you lay in the great ocean and begot me in the waters.

40023106.author: पदार्थः
40023106.content: भोगवन्तम् having hoods, ततः then, नागम् the serpent, अनन्तम् Ananta, उदकेशयम् lying in the water, मायया by Maya, जनयित्वा having created, त्वम् you, द्वौ two, च and, सत्त्वौ beings, महाबलौ very powerful.

40023106.author: Translation
40023106.content: Then, having created by your divine power the hooded serpent Ananta, who lies in the water, you also created two very powerful beings.

40023107.author: पदार्थः
40023107.content: मधुम् Madhu, च and, कैटभम् Kaitabha, च and, एव indeed, ययोः whose, अस्थिचयैः by heaps of bones, वृता covered, इयम् this, पर्वतसम्बाधा crowded with mountains, मेदिनी the earth, च and, अभवत् became, मही the great earth.

40023107.author: Translation
40023107.content: These two were Madhu and Kaitabha, whose heaps of bones covered this earth, which then became the great earth crowded with mountains.

40023108.author: पदार्थः
40023108.content: पद्मे on the lotus, दिव्ये divine, अर्कसङ्काशे sun-like, नाभ्याम् from the navel, उत्पाद्य having created, माम् me, अपि also, प्राजापत्यम् of creation, त्वया by you, कर्म work, मयि in me, सर्वम् all, निवेशितम् entrusted.

40023108.author: Translation
40023108.content: Having created me from your divine, sun-like lotus navel, you entrusted all the work of creation to me.

40023109.author: पदार्थः
40023109.content: सः that, अहम् I, सन्न्यस्तभारः having relinquished the burden, हि indeed, त्वाम् you, उपासे I worship, जगत्पतिम् the lord of the world, रक्षाम् protection, विधत्स्व bestow, भूतेषु for beings, मम my, तेजस्करः increasing the splendor, भवान् you.

40023109.author: Translation
40023109.content: Having indeed relinquished that burden, I now worship you, the Lord of the world; please bestow protection upon all beings and increase my splendor.

40023110.author: पदार्थः
40023110.content: ततः then, त्वम् you, अपि also, दुर्धर्षात् from the unassailable, तस्मात् from that, भावात् state, सनातनात् eternal, रक्षार्थम् for the protection, सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, विष्णुत्वम् the state of Vishnu, उपजग्मिवान् attained.

40023110.author: Translation
40023110.content: Therefore, you also, from that unassailable and eternal state, assumed the form of Vishnu for the protection of all beings.

40023111.author: पदार्थः
40023111.content: अदित्याम् in Aditi, वीर्यवान् powerful, पुत्रः son, भ्रातॄणाम् of brothers, वीर्यवर्धनः increasing the valor, समुत्पन्नेषु when arisen, कृत्येषु in difficulties, तेषाम् their, साह्याय for help, कल्पसे you become capable.

40023111.author: Translation
40023111.content: As a powerful son born to Aditi, increasing the valor of your brothers, you become capable of assisting them when difficulties arise.

40023112.author: पदार्थः
40023112.content: सः that, त्वम् you, वित्रास्यमानासु when being terrified, प्रजासु the creatures, जगताम् of the worlds, वर O best one, रावणस्य of Ravana, वधाकाङ्क्षी desiring the slaying, मानुषेषु among humans, मनः mind, अदधाः you set.

40023112.author: Translation
40023112.content: O best of the worlds, when the creatures were being terrified, you, desiring the slaying of Ravana, set your mind on being born among humans.

40023113.author: पदार्थः
40023113.content: दश ten, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, दश ten, वर्षशतानि hundreds of years, च and, कृत्वा having fixed, वासस्य of dwelling, नियतिं the duration, स्वयमेव by yourself, आत्मना by yourself, पुरा formerly

40023113.author: Translation
40023113.content: Formerly, you yourself fixed the duration of your dwelling (on earth) for ten thousand and ten hundred years.

40023114.author: पदार्थः
40023114.content: स that, त्वं you, मनोमयः born of mind, पुत्रः son, पूर्णायुः having completed your lifespan, मानुषेषु among humans, इह here, कालः time, अयम् this, ते for you, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, समीपम् proximity, उपवर्तितुम् to return

40023114.author: Translation
40023114.content: O best among men, you, the mind-born son, have completed your lifespan among humans here, and now it is time for you to return to my proximity.

40023115.author: पदार्थः
40023115.content: यदि if, भूयः again, महाराज O great king, प्रजाः subjects, इच्छसि you desire, उपासितुम् to rule, वस dwell, वा or, वीर O hero, भद्रं welfare, ते for you, एवम् thus, आह said, पितामहः the grandfather

40023115.author: Translation
40023115.content: The grandfather (Brahma) said, "O great king, if you desire to rule your subjects again, or if you wish to stay, O hero, may good fortune be upon you."

40023116.author: पदार्थः
40023116.content: अथ now, वा or, विजिगीषा desire to go, ते your, सुरलोकाय to the world of gods, राघव O Raghava, सनाथाः protected, विष्णुना by Vishnu, देवाः the gods, भवन्तु may they be, विगतज्वराः free from anxiety

40023116.author: Translation
40023116.content: Or, O Raghava, if you desire to return to the world of the gods, then may the gods be protected by Vishnu and be free from all distress.

40023117.author: पदार्थः
40023117.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, पितामहेन by the grandfather, उक्तं spoken, वाक्यं words, कालसमीरितम् prompted by time, राघवः Rama, प्रहसन् smiling, वाक्यं words, सर्वसंहारम् indicating the dissolution of everything, अब्रवीत् spoke

40023117.author: Translation
40023117.content: Having heard the words spoken by the grandfather, which indicated the end of his time, Rama smiled and spoke words signifying the dissolution of everything.

40023118.author: पदार्थः
40023118.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, मे my, देवदेवस्य of the god of gods, वाक्यं word, परमम् supreme, अद्भुतम् wonderful, प्रीतिः joy, हि indeed, महती great, जाता arisen, तव your, आगमन coming, सम्भवा caused by.

40023118.author: Translation
40023118.content: Having heard the supreme and wonderful words of the god of gods, a great joy has indeed arisen in me, caused by your arrival.

40023119.author: पदार्थः
40023119.content: त्रयाणाम् of the three, अपि even, लोकानाम् of worlds, कार्यार्थम् for the purpose, मम my, सम्भवः existence, भद्रम् welfare, ते to you, अस्तु let it be, गमिष्यामि I shall go, यतः from where, एव indeed, अहम् I, आगतः came.

40023119.author: Translation
40023119.content: My existence is for the purpose of the three worlds; may good fortune be to you, I shall now depart to the place from where I came.

40023120.author: पदार्थः
40023120.content: हद्गतः understood, हि indeed, असि you are, सम्प्राप्तः reached, न not, मे my, तत्र there, विचारणा deliberation, मया by me, हि indeed, सर्वकृत्येषु in all duties, देवानाम् of the gods, वशवर्तिनाम् obedient, स्थातव्यम् must be acted, सर्वसंहार the destruction of all, यथा as, हि indeed, आह said, पितामहः the grandfather.

40023120.author: Translation
40023120.content: You are indeed understood and your time has arrived, there is no doubt in my mind about that; for I must indeed act in all duties, obedient to the gods, for the destruction of all, just as the grandfather Brahma has indeed commanded. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुरधिकशततमः सर्गः ।। 104 ।। Thus ends the hundred and fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
